control.title: Independent annual IS and cyber security audit
control.description: Have qualified, independent auditors (CERT-In empanelled where the regulator requires) audit information systems and cyber security at least yearly, report to the Board or its committee, submit reports to the regulator when required, and track findings to closure.

implementation_notes: Implemented at Paisa Setu Fintech and reviewed annually.
evidence_hint: Audit engagement letter, auditor empanelment or qualifications, audit report, submission acknowledgement, findings tracker.
acceptance_criteria: The audit covers information systems and cyber security and was completed in the last 12 months
The auditor is independent and qualified (CERT-In empanelled where required)
Findings are tracked to closure and the report went to the Board, its committee or the regulator as required

criteria_coverage.criterion: The audit covers information systems and cyber security and was completed in the last 12 months
The auditor is independent and qualified (CERT-In empanelled where required)
Findings are tracked to closure and the report went to the Board, its committee or the regulator as required

requirements.title: Annual system and cyber security audit by a CERT-In empanelled auditor
requirements.guidance: Submit an annual system audit, including a cyber security audit by a CERT-In empanelled auditor, to the DPSS regional office.

requirements.title: Quarterly auditor certificate on escrow
requirements.guidance: Get an auditor certificate on escrow balances every quarter, by the 15th of the following month.

evidence.title: Independent annual IS and cyber security audit: how we do it
evidence.description: Implemented at Paisa Setu Fintech and reviewed annually.
